prompt: Reskin image 1, an authored 3D long greenhouse capture, into a finished hand-painted greenhouse game prop. Keep the rigid greenhouse outer geometry and square-grid alignment; no peaked redesign, rotated base or extra structures. Preserve the complete 1024x1152 reference canvas and 8:9 aspect, exact original placement and transparent margins. Runtime frame is 512x576 with central ground anchor (256,376) of the whole 3x2 footprint; do not fit or recenter the visible roof. Return the complete single greenhouse object on genuine transparency, no external ground, cast shadow, decorative outline/glow, labels or other objects.
